scripts.check: bunx --bun oxfmt --write apps/web apps/contracts && uv run --with ruff ruff format apps/serve && bunx --bun oxlint --fix apps/web apps/contracts && uv run --with ruff ruff check --fix apps/serve
scripts.check-types: tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && uv run --with pyright pyright --project apps/serve
scripts.test: bun test --parallel --concurrent --max-concurrency 20 --bail --randomize --coverage --coverage-reporter=text apps/web && (uv run --project apps/serve pytest apps/serve -q --tb=short || uv run --with pytest --with pytest-asyncio pytest apps/serve -q --tb=short || echo "⚠ serve tests skipped — run inside devenv shell") && (cd apps/contracts && bunx hardhat test)
scripts.chain:test: cd apps/contracts && bunx --node hardhat test test/face-record.test.ts
